;Disasters and accidents
*[[List of fireworks accidents and incidents|Fireworks accidents and incidents]]
**Two explosions at fireworks workshops in [[Tultepec]], [[Mexico]], kill at least 19 people, including rescue workers, and injure dozens more. Tultepec is home to a major fireworks industry. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-blast/at-least-16-people-killed-in-fireworks-blast-outside-mexico-city-idUSKBN1JV2I4 (Reuters)]
*[[2018 Phuket boat capsizing]]
**At least 33 are dead and 23 missing after two passenger boats capsize off [[Phuket Province|Phuket]], [[Thailand]]. All are [[China|Chinese]] tourists. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/07/06/world/asia/boats-sink-phuket-thailand-tourists.html (''The New York Times'')]

**[[Iran]] threatens to close the [[Strait of Hormuz]] to shipping if the [[U.S.]] re-applies sanctions to the country after the U.S withdrew from the [[JCPOA]] deal earlier in the year. *[[Environmental policy of the first Trump administration|Environmental policy of the Donald Trump administration]]
**[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces the [[List of Trump administration dismissals and resignations|resignation]] of [[Scott Pruitt]] as [[Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency|Administrator]] of the [[United States Environmental Protection Agency|Environmental Protection Agency]]. Former coal lobbyist [[Andrew R. Wheeler]] will act as a temporary replacement. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/07/05/andrew-wheeler-will-replace-scott-pruitt-as-acting-epa-administrator.html (CNBC)]
